description.zh:
指定算力类别。取值范围：

- economy：经济型
- general：通用型
description.en:
The computing power category. Valid values:

- economy: economy

- general: general-purpose

description.zh: 实例ID序列。最多20个，字符串需按照JSON格式传入。
description.en: The IDs of the instances. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

description.zh: 实例名称，即容器组名称。
description.en: The name of the instance, which is also the name of the container group.

description.zh:
限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设置，默认返回20个，最大不能超过20个。

> 返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
description.en:
The number of resources to return. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 20.

> The number of returned resources may be less than but will not be greater than the specified value.

description.zh:
下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。

> 首次查询时无需设置该参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取。
description.en:
The token that marks the start of the next query. If this parameter is empty, no more results are returned.

> You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. The token for a subsequent query is obtained from the response to the previous query.
The region ID of the instance.
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.
The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

description.zh:
实例状态。取值范围：

- Pending：启动中
- Running：运行中
- Succeeded：运行成功
- Failed：运行失败
- Scheduling：创建中
- ScheduleFailed：创建失败
- Restarting：重启中
- Updating：更新中
- Terminating：终止中
- Expired：过期
description.en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

- Pending: The instance is starting.

- Running: The instance is running.

- Succeeded: The instance ran successfully.

- Failed: The instance failed to run.

- Scheduling: The instance is being created.

- ScheduleFailed: The instance failed to be created.

- Restarting: The instance is being restarted.

- Updating: The instance is being updated.

- Terminating: The instance is being stopped.

- Expired: The instance has expired.
The tag key of the instance.
The tag value of the instance.

description.zh: 实例所属的虚拟交换机ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual switch to which the instance is connected.
Specifies whether to return event information.

description.zh:
实例所属的可用区。如果取值为空，则表示由系统选择。

默认值为空。
description.en:
The zone where the instance is located. If you leave this parameter empty, the system selects a zone.

The default value is empty.

descriptions.zh:
- 当ECI实例运行终止后，底层计算资源将会被回收。随实例一起创建的其它资源（例如EIP等）默认随实例一起释放。
- 终态（处于Failed、Succeeded或Expired状态）实例的元数据信息的保留情况如下：
    - 1小时内的实例信息全部保留。
    - 超出1小时的实例仅保留最近的100条（单个地域分别计算）。
- 如果使用RAM用户账号或者RAM角色进行查询，当RAM用户或者角色缺乏接口权限时，会返回空列表。
descriptions.en:
- When an ECI instance stops running, its underlying computing resources are reclaimed. Other resources that are created with the instance, such as EIPs, are released with the instance by default.

- The metadata of instances in a terminal state (Failed, Succeeded, or Expired) is retained as follows:

  - All metadata of instances created within the last hour is retained.

  - For instances that are older than one hour, only the metadata of the last 100 instances in each region is retained.

- If you make the query using a RAM user or RAM role that does not have the required API permissions, an empty list is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-container-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --vswitch-id vsw-bp1jrgfqqy54kg5hc0000 --next-token d78f2dd8-5979-42fe-0000-b16db43be5bc --limit 20 --container-group-ids eci-bp17gw49eu09yiwm0000_,_eci-bp19aq49du01abcm0000_,_eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000 --container-group-name test --status Running --resource-group-id rg-aekzh43v00000 --with-event true --tag Value=test Key=name --compute-category economy --security-group-id sg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
